title: The ending states 'The reeve of Last Light never got his watch shield back, nor a word of why' as a consequence, but the watch shield remained in my inventory for the entire game — no dialogue option or prompt to return it was ever offered, so the game narrates a 'failure' for an action I was never given a chance to take.
